# Third-party components

OptiMiyoo bundles these tools for Windows conversion. Each has its own authors
and license; source archives and build details are linked below.

| Component | Purpose | Bundled version | License and source |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [NIBTools](https://github.com/rittwage/nibtools) | C64 NIB/NBZ to G64 conversion | 20241120 | [License](nibtools/LICENSE.txt) · [Source and build](nibtools/SOURCE.txt) |
| [HxC Floppy Emulator](https://github.com/jfdelnero/HxCFloppyEmulator) | ZX Spectrum IPF to DSK conversion | 2.16.13.1 | [Notices](hxc/COPYING_FULL) · [Source and build](hxc/SOURCE.txt) |
| [CAPSIMG](https://github.com/FrodeSolheim/capsimg) | IPF decoding for HxC | FS-UAE Windows: 5.1.3 x64; 5.1fs3 x86 | [License](capsimg/LICENSE.txt) · [Source](capsimg/SOURCE.txt) |
| [GCC](https://gcc.gnu.org/) / [MinGW-w64](https://www.mingw-w64.org/), packaged by [MSYS2](https://github.com/msys2/MINGW-packages) | Runtime libraries for x86 CAPSIMG | [Package list](runtime/packages.json) | [Licenses and packages](runtime/SOURCE.txt) |

**CAPSIMG's included license restricts commercial use.**
These component licenses do not define a license for OptiMiyoo's own code.
